contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could have been done, yet describes an unmet ask for a customer-specific cost number, no contact with finance, and an ROI session never held.
Diane is named decider with 'I guess', never met or in any meeting, and all knowledge is secondhand via Owen.
Rep first says nothing got silence, then names the revenue framing, which Owen explicitly rejected.
Rep says 'in procurement', then corrects to 'we'd sent paper', so procurement stage is overstated.
Rep frames the freeze as not a decision against us, yet earlier says 'we' lost momentum when the payback ask went unmet and CFO saw it as nice to have.
Rep says timing will resolve next year, but engineering lead says no billing changes before renewal season, and finance saw it as nice to have.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got silence?
dodges.what: Started with 'I don't know that anything got silence', then guessed revenue framing.

dodges.question: Who made the final call, and how do you know?
dodges.what: Answered 'The CFO, I guess?' and reframed as a freeze on everything; basis was only Owen's report.

dodges.question: When did you first feel this wasn't going to close? What happened right before?
dodges.what: Gave only the freeze email at first; the payback ask came only after a follow-up.

dodges.question: Anything else?
dodges.what: Closed with 'nothing we could have done' despite earlier describing gaps.
